findings.summary: Round 2 feature review of GENERATION-LOCAL-01 at 99558b8 (planning checkout readable this time). The ten granted app paths plus REPORT and the attributed r1 record are the only changes. They conform to architecture v1.2 SHA256 02adc2e0…: ADR-E03 commits the job, attempt and fence before mock work, holds no transaction across the provider await, and lease/fence/consent/profile/founder rechecks fence late or cancelled work, with no automatic retry. ADR-E04 gives immutable keyed-digest successor revisions with publish_authority=false, empty review evidence and no publish path. ADR-E05/06 hold: household lock before consent, founder rechecked inside and after the independent journal append, retryable_unacknowledged with original-key reconciliation, unacknowledged history blocking new work, and usage unknown and never billed zero. The 00-B fixture-1 adventure fields and constants match exactly. 00-C SC08 holds (new digest, no inherited approval). The worker graph (generation-service → continuation-journal, request-queue, queue-journal, environment, draft-fixture, fixture-adventure, PGlite) imports only node:crypto/fs/path/util and has no network or credential capability. Controller evidence on 99558b8 passed: 129 tests, build, unmodified 04-C checker (12 probes, 27/32 baseline, 76 routes, private scans) and the independent fixture probe. Carrying the CUA forward is sufficient: commits 48e5e3c and 99558b8 change only the review record, REPORT and doc, so all seven runtime blobs equal 0178ad6, where all eight scenarios actually ran, and a new login/save/run/edit/diff smoke ran on 99558b8. Only nonblocking gaps remain. Full 05-A/05-G stay OPEN; nothing here proves provider, content or family readiness.

findings.title: No test asserts invalid, non-empty mock limits fail
findings.problem: The card requires that 'Constructor and meaningful service tests assert missing/invalid limits fail'. The service test only passes limits:{}, which is the missing case, and the root probe has no limits case. Inspection shows validateMockLimits (ownData exact keys plus canonical equality with MOCK_LIMITS) rejects any changed value, unknown key or proxy. The behaviour is therefore correct, but the invalid-value criterion has no executable evidence.
findings.fix_check: In a later authorized revision, tests reject e.g. {...MOCK_LIMITS,provider_timeout_ms:2000}, an extra key and a missing single key.

findings.title: Carried setup-r2 minor: setup review history still not git-guarded
findings.problem: setup_pass checks that setup-r*.json names are consecutive and match their logs. The GENERATION-LOCAL-SETUP directory is still absent from WATCHED and has no validate_review_changes history check, unlike feature_history. Setup-r1 (changes_requested at aee829b) and setup-r2 (pass at 7117fda) are present and internally consistent with the narrative, but I could not inspect git history read-only. This was explicitly carried, not fixed, so it must not be described as fixed.
findings.fix_check: setup_pass applies validate_review_changes to the setup directory across planning history, and a unit test with a modified setup-r1 is refused.

findings.title: Recovered StartMock 'never ran' state is documented but not shown in UI
findings.problem: Carried from r1. The doc now states that a reconciled StartMock never dispatches and becomes uncertain at lease expiry. The UI still shows 'Mock work running; no draft is confirmed', then the generic uncertain text, without telling the founder that the run may never have started. This fails safe (no retry, no draft), but r1's fix check asked for doc and UI copy.
findings.fix_check: The uncertain/running copy, or a test, covers the reconciled-start path explicitly.

findings.title: O03 failed state hides validation details
findings.problem: 00-C maps validation_failed to 'O03 shows rejected draft/errors'. Invalid output is correctly retained as restricted_invalid_output in the encrypted fact (ADR-E03), but the workbench shows only a generic failed message. This is acceptable for the partial slice and belongs to the whole 05-A editor.
findings.fix_check: Whole-card editor work renders safe field-level validation errors for failed drafts.

findings.title: Client oversize pre-check is reported as 'confirmation unknown'
findings.problem: If the client's 16384-character check fires, the error carries no status, so perform() keeps the intent and offers 'Retry' for a command that was never sent. The textarea maxlength of 6002 currently makes this unreachable; multibyte overflow reaches the server's 413, which is handled as a rejection, as documented.
findings.fix_check: The client measures UTF-8 bytes and throws a status-bearing rejection, so that state cannot be shown as unknown.
